Name: Gremory's Emblem
Basic Side: When two or more water units enter the exhaust after combat, gain a Rose Unit Token. It is a Tier I Unit that replaces one of your water Tier I Units. It gains the Attack and Defense of the removed unit. Replaced units are in the Exile Zone.
Condition: If all three Tier I Units that were removed to create Rose Token Units were Lorelei: Transform Gremory.
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.

Name: Zepar's Emblem
Basic Side: When your water Unit reveals itself, you can transform that Unit into a Swan creature type. Swan creature types get +1 Attack Power during Unit Combat.
Condition: If you have transformed 5 Lorelei units into Swans: Transform Zepar.
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.

Name: Sallos's Emblem
Basic Side: When your water unit defends and wins combat get a Song counter and place it permanently on an enemy Unit.
Condition: If five different enemy units have Song Counters on them: Transform Sallos.
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.
